1800-2000-0002-0021.message: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.

1800-3500-0001-0002.message: AMS-HT A The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.

1800-4000-0002-0001.message: AMS-HT A Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.

1800-7000-0002-0001.message: Failed to pull out the AMS-HT A filament from the extruder. Possible cause: clogged extruder or broken filament inside the extruder.

1800-7000-0002-0004.message: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT A filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

1800-7000-0002-0005.message: Failed to feed the AMS-HT A filament. Please trim the end of the filament and check if the spool is stuck.

1800-7000-0002-0007.message: AMS-HT filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.

1800-8000-0001-0001.message: AMS-HT A heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.

1800-8000-0001-0004.message: AMS-HT A The heater is heating abnormally.
